name: Ichirō Tsutomu
concept: Ichirō still has the shoulders and chest of a sumai wrestler, though he has not fought in several months.

answers.stand_out: Ichirō waits longer than other grapplers before committing his weight. It cost him tournaments. It makes him hard to provoke in an interrogation.

answers.social_giri: Ichirō keeps Kasuga Chiyo's books balanced and her debtors reminded. It pays better than sumai did, and the work is standing still until he has to move.

answers.social_ninjo: Ichirō wants the sumai stable in the interior kept open, and pays for it out of Chiyo's wages. Chiyo has not asked why.

answers.clan_relations: Ichirō agrees with the Badger principle that a tool should do its job well. He does his so thoroughly that Chiyo's debtors fear him more than the debt, and she has to step in to negotiate terms he would simply enforce.

answers.success: He talked a man out of throwing himself off the docks by sitting beside him for two hours without speaking, then walked away when the man stood up, and left the man's debt to Chiyo uncollected.

answers.difficulty: Ichirō threw bouts early in his career, and someone who knows is using it to bind him into errands he cannot refuse without exposure.

answers.calms: Ichirō sits with the stable master in the interior and listens to how each fighter he pays for has trained that week. When he leaves he can repeat the master's doubt about one man's shoulder and the bout where another found his opening.

answers.worries: Ichirō cannot pass up flirting with someone he finds attractive, and when they flirt back his interest becomes obvious to everyone watching.

answers.most_learn: Ichirō Namiyo — Ichirō's mother Namiyo taught him that strength meant holding still when it would be easier to move; he learned it watching her refuse to flinch when his father drank. He sends money to a stable in her name.

answers.first_sight: Ichirō still has the shoulders and chest of a sumai wrestler, though he has not fought in several months.

answers.stress: When pressed past composure, Ichirō takes out a small blade and trims his fingernails in short strokes until someone speaks to him directly or he draws blood.

answers.relations:
Kaito Koin (Phoenix) — Ichirō met Kaito Koin at a sumai bout in the interior three years ago. Koin recognized the stable master's name from somewhere official, asked questions Ichirō should not have answered, and never reported the money flowing through that town. Since then Ichirō does small favors Koin asks for through intermediaries, none of them reaching Chiyo.
Kasuga Sanjiro (Tortoise) — Kasuga Sanjiro trained under the same sumai master Ichirō sends money to and left the sport before Ichirō did. When they cross paths at the stable, Sanjiro watches him hand over the coin and says nothing.

answers.parents_pov: His mother Namiyo, now dead, would have approved of the money he sends to the stable in her name. His father would have called it throwing away what he earned.

answers.death: Ichirō dies pinned under a falling beam in a fire at the stable, having gone back in for the stable master after everyone else was out.
